peers.name: hyperframes
peers.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

peers.name: hyperframes-cli
peers.description: HyperFrames CLI - scaffold, check frames, edit timelines, preview, render, share and project history; read JSON and recover from failures.

peers.name: media-use
peers.description: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.

peers.name: hyperframes-registry
peers.description: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.

en.tagline: Port Remotion and other animation code into HyperFrames
en.summary: This skill moves existing video code or footage into HyperFrames. It covers Remotion first, and also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, p5.js, canvas, plain HTML/CSS animation, and renders from Manim, After Effects or Blender. It then checks the result frame by frame against the original.
problem: You have finished video work made with another tool and want it in HyperFrames. Some of it can be rewritten as HTML and GSAP, some can run as-is in a browser, and some exists only as rendered video.
Each part is brought in at the highest level it supports. The skill records the level used, and it compares the new project with the original at set times and across the full render.
fit: Porting a Remotion composition to HyperFrames sub-compositions
Keeping a canvas, p5.js or Three.js animation and driving its timing from HyperFrames
Reusing a Manim, After Effects or Blender render as a clip in a HyperFrames project
unfit: Code that uses React state or effects, or React UI kits, which cannot be translated and must be hosted or refactored
Animation that depends on wall-clock time, live physics or the network, which can only be used as a rendered clip
steps: Sort each part into Native, Hosted or Media, based on what it outputs and whether it can be drawn for any requested time.
For Remotion source, run `lint_source.py` first to find blockers and warnings.
Translate Native parts into one sub-composition per scene, with times in seconds and root-relative asset paths.
Turn source props into editable `data-composition-variables`, and mount reused components with `data-variable-values`.
Compare the project with the original using `npx hyperframes diff`, sampling every scene and both sides of each cut, then compare the full render.
Write anything that did not translate cleanly to `TRANSLATION_NOTES.md`.

zh.summary: 这个技能把已有的视频代码或素材迁入 HyperFrames。优先支持 Remotion，也支持 Motion Canvas、Lottie、Three.js、p5.js、canvas、纯 HTML/CSS 动画，以及 Manim、After Effects、Blender 输出的渲染结果。迁移后，它会逐帧与原始视频对比，检查结果是否一致。
problem: 你用其他工具做完了一段视频，想放到 HyperFrames 里继续使用。其中一部分可以改写成 HTML 和 GSAP，一部分可以在浏览器中直接运行，还有一部分只以渲染好的视频形式存在。
每个部分都按它支持的最高层级引入，技能会记录所用的层级。它还会在指定时间点和完整渲染结果上，把新项目与原始版本做对比。
fit: 把 Remotion 作品迁移为 HyperFrames 子合成
保留 canvas、p5.js 或 Three.js 动画，由 HyperFrames 控制其时间
把 Manim、After Effects 或 Blender 的渲染结果作为片段放入 HyperFrames 项目
unfit: 依赖 React 状态、effect 或 React UI 组件库的代码，无法直接翻译，只能托管或重构
依赖实时时钟、实时物理或网络的动画，只能作为渲染好的片段使用
steps: 按照输出形式以及能否在任意指定时间绘制画面，把每个部分归入 Native、Hosted 或 Media。
对 Remotion 源码，先运行 `lint_source.py`，找出阻断项和警告项。
把 Native 部分翻译为每个场景一个子合成，时间以秒为单位，素材路径使用根相对路径。
把源码的 props 转为可编辑的 `data-composition-variables`，复用的组件通过 `data-variable-values` 挂载。
用 `npx hyperframes diff` 将项目与原始视频对比，逐场景抽样，并检查每个切点的两侧，然后对完整渲染结果再做一次对比。
把没有干净翻译的内容记录到 `TRANSLATION_NOTES.md`。
